name: trial-width144-seed17
hypothesis: Increasing the shared convolution width from 128 to 144 will reduce acoustic prediction error across languages while staying below one million learned inference parameters. The full baseline's true-duration diagnostics give little consistent improvement, whereas accurate-control reconstruction has lower recognition error in English, Mandarin, Spanish and German. This makes capacity a more direct first test than changing duration supervision.
constraints: Random initialization, all five languages, same seed 17, 50000 optimizer steps and five clips per batch. Actual elapsed compute is reported separately. The frozen per-language promotion rule remains unchanged. Any nomination still requires repeat seeds and browser qualification.
